# Kalindi Marketing

> Helping businesses dominate search engines, AI answer engines, and generative AI platforms.

Kalindi Marketing is an India-based full-stack digital marketing agency specializing in SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).

## Core Services
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Social Media Marketing
- PPC & Paid Advertising
- Content Marketing
